description: This Java class `CreateBsonVisitor` implements the `CriteriaVisitor<Bson>` interface to generate BSON filters for MongoDB queries based on search criteria and authorization restrictions. It creates BSON objects that represent query filters, considering visibility restrictions and excluding deleted entities.

classes.name: CreateBsonVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class for constructing BSON query filters from criteria, considering authorization restrictions and excluding deleted entities.

methods.name: CreateBsonVisitor
methods.description: Private constructor initializing authorizationSubjectIds for filtering scope.

methods.name: sudoApply
methods.description: Creates BSON for criteria querying without visibility restrictions, excluding delete filter for stats-only counts.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Creates BSON for criteria querying with specified authorization subject IDs and global read permissions, additionally filtering out deleted items.

methods.name: visitExists
methods.description: Creates BSON for an exists field expression via a helper visitor.

methods.name: visitField
methods.description: Creates BSON for a field filter expression with specific predicate.

methods.name: visitAny
methods.description: Returns an empty BSON document, representing no additional criteria.

methods.name: visitNor
methods.description: Creates a BSON representing a logical NOR of multiple filters.

methods.name: visitOr
methods.description: Creates a BSON representing a logical OR of multiple filters.

methods.name: visitAnd
methods.description: Creates a BSON representing a logical AND of multiple filters.
